$comment: SP01 metric thresholds (PRD Metrics table, verbatim in `threshold`; machine-readable limits in `limits`). Source of truth for visual:check and CHECKLIST.md Appendix B. status: cal = measured on the refs, prov = provisional (T8 confirms/fixes; afterwards only tightened). px limits are given at `pxBaseHeight` (or the limit's own `atHeight`) and scaled by viewport height. Never lower a threshold to make a capture pass.

M01.name: tower screen width, % viewport height (median owned tower)

M02.name: count digit height / tower bbox width (roof number)
M02.note: PRD Source column: card area / tower area <=1.0 (limits.cardArea)

M03.name: count on roof: roof-decal mesh inside model rect AND hasCard none AND M17=0

M06.name: troop on-screen height, % viewport height; /tower width

M09.name: grass share inside the play quad (ground.playQuadScreen)

M10.name: border (outside the play quad): sand+rock share, grass share, border area
M10.threshold: sand+rock >=0.60 of border pixels, grass <=0.05 of border, border area >=10% of frame

M11.name: tower paint (owned: team-sat/sat, team-sat/fg, white/fg; neutral: sat/fg, grey+white/fg)
M11.note: PRD Metric column: (a) team-sat share of saturated fg pixels >=0.85; (b) team-sat / fg 0.35-0.72 and never >=0.80; (c) white-body / fg 0.15-0.45. Neutral towers: saturated pixels <=5% of fg and grey+white >=90% of fg

M12.name: head-on: 1 lane per pair, crossing lane separate, split error vs most recent Clash
M12.note: PRD Metric column: unsettled frames k ticks later (+6 PNG, splitTrace ticks): tolerance = 12 px + projected front-closure distance over k ticks (<= 2 x troop speed x k / TICK_RATE)

M13.name: perf (l18, 5 s real time, fresh page, no clock): fps, p95 frame ms, drawCalls, jsMs p95
M13.threshold: `gpu:true`: fps>=55; always: drawCalls<=100, jsMs p95<=8; fps on SwiftShader = `informational`

M14.name: grass share of the whole frame

M15.name: towers in frame: min edge margin; tightest-axis union margin
M15.threshold: min margin >=0.02 and tightest-axis union margin <=0.10

M16.name: roof number glyph height in px (outlined white-fill digit incl. its outline ring, tallest digit)
M16.threshold: >=12 px at 1366x768 L1 (scaled by viewport height elsewhere); >=10 px at L18

M18.name: palette distance (TV of class shares) vs best mapped ref: (i) whole frame, (ii) first owned tower crop

M19.name: roof-decal pixel visibility: outlined white number centred in the upper roof on a lit plate (height >= 0.10 x tower width) + dot count under it == sim slots

M20.name: floor stripes along the vertical centre line: white runs between team bands
M20.threshold: runs within [floors-1, floors+1] and >=1 team-sat band run per white run
